data.title: Riwa
data.about:
Meraas Riwa stands as the latest gem in the urban landscape of Madinat Jumeirah Living, introducing a modern touch with its contemporary architectural ethos. This development, known as Riwa at Madinat Jumeirah Living (Riwa MJL), provides luminous, sophisticated, and generously sized living areas, including exclusive 1 to 4 bedroom homes. Nestled among unspoiled beaches, verdant walkways, and under the watchful eye of the majestic Burj Al Arab, Riwa Meraas embodies a lifestyle of luxury and distinction. This community at Madinat Jumeirah Living invites you to indulge in an exceptional way of life, day in and day out, where every moment is extraordinary.

Adding to the charm and uniqueness of Madinat Jumeirah Living is its vast parkland, which brings a special flavor to the neighborhood with a variety of sought-after facilities and services designed for residents of all ages, making living in Meraas Riwa a truly elevated experience.

characteristics_module.title: An Elevated Living Experience at Riwa by Meraas
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Contemporary Design: Meraas Riwa features modern architecture and elegant interiors within Madinat Jumeirah Living.
  • Luxurious Finishes: Premium finishes in all units of Riwa at Madinat Jumeirah Living ensure a high-end living experience.
  • Unique Landscaping: Riwa MJL stands out with its distinctive contemporary landscape design.
  • Optimized Views: Every unit in Riwa Meraas is designed to maximize scenic views.
  • Wellness Focused: Infinity pool, 360-degree gym, sky gardens, and a roof terrace cater to well-being at Riwa at MJL.
  • Prime Location: Situated in Dubai’s Madinat neighborhood, offering vibrant living and exceptional amenities.
  • High Standards: Riwa Meraas combines luxury, style, and comfort, meeting the highest quality standards.

location_tile.title: Live in the Heart of Exclusivity at Riwa MJL
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled between the dynamic Al Wasl and the scenic Jumeirah Beach Roads, Meraas Riwa at Madinat Jumeirah Living (Riwa MJL) offers a gateway to a lifestyle infused with luxury and elegance. This coveted location ensures seamless access to the finest in luxury retail, gourmet dining, and expansive leisure and entertainment options. Riwa Meraas residences are designed to redefine what modern elegance means, blending contemporary comforts with a touch of traditional aesthetics. Madinat Jumeirah Living is more than a place—it's a panorama of sea-front views and enchanting sunset vistas. Surrounded by pristine beaches, lush greenery, and the iconic Burj Al Arab, residents of Meraas Riwa can indulge in a life of elevated living every single day.

  • 2-minute drive to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 5-minute drive to Mall of the Emirates
  • 10-minute drive to Palm Jumeirah
  • 15-minute drive to Bluewaters Island
  • 17-minute drive to Dubai Mall
  • 25-minute drive to Dubai International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Discover luxury at Riwa Apartments by Meraas, nestled in Madinat Jumeirah Living. Explore Riwa MJL for premium living in Dubai's vibrant heart.

more_info.answer: Riwa MJL is a prestigious residential development by Meraas, situated in the heart of the iconic Madinat Jumeirah Living community in Dubai. It offers contemporary designed apartments with modern interiors and premium finishes, catering to a luxurious lifestyle.
more_info.question: What is Riwa at Madinat Jumeirah Living (Riwa MJL)?

more_info.answer: Riwa at Madinat Jumeirah Living provides a selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom luxury apartments, each designed with modern elegance and high-end finishes to ensure a premium living experience.
more_info.question: What types of residences are available at Riwa Meraas?

more_info.answer: Residents of Meraas Riwa have access to a variety of wellness facilities, including an infinity pool, a 360-degree view gym, sky gardens, and a roof terrace, all designed to enhance the well-being and lifestyle of its inhabitants.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents enjoy at Meraas Riwa?

more_info.answer: Located between Al Wasl and Jumeirah Beach Roads, Riwa MJL offers easy access to luxury retail, gourmet dining, leisure, and entertainment options, making it a prime location for those seeking a dynamic and upscale living environment.
more_info.question: How does the location of Riwa MJL benefit its residents?

more_info.answer: Riwa stands out due to its unique contemporary landscape design, optimized unit layouts for premium views, and its inclusion within the Madinat Jumeirah Living community, known for its luxurious lifestyle and exceptional amenities.
more_info.question: What makes Riwa at MJL stand out from other residential developments?

more_info.answer: Interested buyers can contact the Meraas sales office directly or visit the Madinat Jumeirah Living website for more information on availability, pricing, and viewing appointments for Riwa at Madinat Jumeirah Living residences.
